
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/morec/p/19108409" title="发布于 2025-09-24 00:24">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">NetCore+Web客户端实现gRPC实时推送</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>之前出过websocket推送，sse推送，grpc的推送应该更具性价比，虽然前端要求复杂了一点点。下面快速的一步一步完成一个netcore服务端+web客户端的推送。</p>
<p>后端项目结构</p>
<p>GrpcRealtimePush/<br>├── Services/<br>│   └── ChatService.cs          # gRPC服务实现<br>├── Protos/<br>│   └── chat.proto              # Protocol Buffers定义<br>├── Program.cs                  # 服务启动配置<br>├── GrpcRealtimePush.csproj     # 项目文件<br>└── appsettings.json           # 配置文件</p>
<p>1.安装必要的grpc包</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;Project Sdk=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
  &lt;PropertyGroup&gt;
    &lt;TargetFramework&gt;net9.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>&lt;/TargetFramework&gt;
    &lt;Nullable&gt;enable&lt;/Nullable&gt;
    &lt;ImplicitUsings&gt;enable&lt;/ImplicitUsings&gt;
  &lt;/PropertyGroup&gt;

  &lt;ItemGroup&gt;
    &lt;Protobuf Include=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Protos\chat.proto</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> GrpcServices=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Server</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
  &lt;/ItemGroup&gt;

  &lt;ItemGroup&gt;
    &lt;PackageReference Include=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Grpc.AspNetCore</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> Version=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2.64.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
    &lt;PackageReference Include=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Grpc.AspNetCore.Web</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> Version=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2.64.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
  &lt;/ItemGroup&gt;
&lt;/Project&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>2.创建好proto文件</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>syntax = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">proto3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

package chat;

option csharp_namespace </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GrpcRealtimePush</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 服务定义</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">service ChatService {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 服务端流式推送方法</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  rpc StartRealtimePush(RealtimePushRequest) returns (stream RealtimePushResponse);
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 请求消息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">message RealtimePushRequest {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> client_id = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>;    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 客户端ID</span>
  int64 timestamp = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>;      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 时间戳</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 响应消息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">message RealtimePushResponse {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> data = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>;          <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 推送数据</span>
  int64 timestamp = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>;      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 时间戳</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> data_type = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>;     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数据类型</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<p>proto文件定义就这样：</p>
<p>- **`service ChatService`**: 定义gRPC服务<br>- **`rpc StartRealtimePush`**: 服务端流式方法，返回 `stream`表示持续推送<br>- **`message`**: 定义请求和响应的数据结构<br>- **字段编号**: 1, 2, 3等是字段的唯一标识，用于序列化</p>
<p>3.实现上面的方法</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Grpc.Core;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GrpcRealtimePush.Services;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatService : GrpcRealtimePush.ChatService.ChatServiceBase
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> ILogger&lt;ChatService&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _logger;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ChatService(ILogger&lt;ChatService&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> logger)
    {
        _logger </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> logger;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task StartRealtimePush(RealtimePushRequest request, 
        IServerStreamWriter</span>&lt;RealtimePushResponse&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> responseStream, ServerCallContext context)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🚀 实时推送已启动! 客户端: {ClientId}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, request.ClientId);
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 开始连续数据推送</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> counter = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> random = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Random();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> dataTypes = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">系统状态</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用户活动</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">数据更新</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">通知消息</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">性能指标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
            
            _logger.LogInformation(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🔄 开始连续数据推送循环...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (!context.CancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested &amp;&amp; counter &lt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟不同类型的实时数据</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> dataType =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dataTypes[random.Next(dataTypes.Length)];
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> value = random.Next(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> timestamp =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTime.UtcNow;
                
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> response = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RealtimePushResponse
                {
                    Data </span>= $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#{counter:D4} - 数值: {value} | 时间: {timestamp:HH:mm:ss.fff}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                    Timestamp </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds(),
                    DataType </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dataType
                };

                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> responseStream.WriteAsync(response);
                _logger.LogInformation(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📡 推送数据 #{Counter}: [{DataType}] = {Value} at {Time}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 
                    counter, dataType, value, timestamp.ToString(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HH:mm:ss.fff</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
                
                counter</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 等待2秒后发送下一条数据</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> Task.Delay(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, context.CancellationToken);
            }
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发送完成消息</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> responseStream.WriteAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RealtimePushResponse
            {
                Data </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">实时推送测试完成！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                Timestamp </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds(),
                DataType </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">系统消息</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            });
            
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            _logger.LogInformation(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">实时推送会话已取消，客户端: {ClientId}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, request.ClientId);
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">实时推送会话出错: {Error}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, ex.Message);
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 尝试向客户端发送错误消息</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> responseStream.WriteAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RealtimePushResponse
                {
                    Data </span>= $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">服务器错误: {ex.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                    Timestamp </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds(),
                    DataType </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误消息</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                });
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception sendError)
            {
                _logger.LogError(sendError, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">发送错误消息失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
        }
        
        _logger.LogInformation(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">实时推送会话结束，客户端: {ClientId}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, request.ClientId);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>4.Program文件</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GrpcRealtimePush.Services;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> builder =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加gRPC服务</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">builder.Services.AddGrpc();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置CORS策略，支持gRPC-Web</span>
builder.Services.AddCors(options =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    options.AddPolicy(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AllowAll</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, policy =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        policy.AllowAnyOrigin()
              .AllowAnyMethod()
              .AllowAnyHeader()
              .WithExposedHeaders(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Grpc-Status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Grpc-Message</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Grpc-Encoding</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Grpc-Accept-Encoding</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Content-Type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    });
});

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> app =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> builder.Build();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置HTTP请求管道

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 启用CORS</span>
app.UseCors(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AllowAll</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 启用gRPC-Web中间件</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">app.UseGrpcWeb();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置HTTPS重定向（gRPC-Web需要）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">app.UseHttpsRedirection();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 映射gRPC服务并启用gRPC-Web支持</span>
app.MapGrpcService&lt;ChatService&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">().EnableGrpcWeb();

app.MapGet(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, () =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Communication with gRPC endpoints must be made through a gRPC client. To learn how to create a client, visit: https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2086909</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

app.Run();</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>以上代码对于后端来说应该轻车熟路，后端服务就这样起来了。</p>
<p>先测试一下后端服务是否正常，我这里有go环境，直接安装grpcurl工具。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 安装grpcurl工具
go install github.com</span>/fullstorydev/grpcurl/cmd/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">grpcurl@latest

# 测试服务
grpcurl -insecure localhost:5201 list</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>grpcurl -insecure -d <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{\"client_id\":\"test-client\",\"timestamp\":1234567890}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> localhost:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5201</span> chat.ChatService/StartRealtimePush</pre>
</div>

<p><img alt="Snipaste_2025-09-23_23-58-34" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202509/1099890-20250923235841159-520475694.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>下面就是完成前端代码了，这里使用js+html。</p>
<p><br>前端的结构如下：</p>
<p>client/<br>├── generated/                          # 生成的代码<br>│   ├── chat_pb_browser.js              # Protocol Buffers消息类<br>│   └── chat_grpc_web_pb_browser.js     # gRPC服务客户端<br>├── grpc-web-shim.js                    # gRPC-Web兼容层<br>├── client.js                           # 主要业务逻辑<br>├── index.html                          # 用户界面<br><br>前端准备工作安装protoc和插件。protoc把后端的proto文件转成两个js文件，插件就是grpc链接需要的。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 安装Protocol Buffers编译器
# Windows: 下载 https:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/releases</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># macOS: brew install protobuf
# Linux: apt</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> install protobuf-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">compiler

# 验证安装
protoc </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">version

# 安装gRPC</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Web插件
npm install </span>-g grpc-web</pre>
</div>
<p>核心转换代码脚本如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>protoc -I=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">GrpcRealtimePush\Protos `
  </span>--js_out=import_style=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">commonjs:client\generated `
  </span>--grpc-web_out=import_style=commonjs,mode=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">grpcwebtext:client\generated `
  GrpcRealtimePush\Protos\chat.proto</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>执行了protoc后会生成下面2个js文件</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>下面就需要创建连接层代码，该代码手动创建,有需要可以拷贝更改复用。</p>
<p>`grpc-web-shim.js`</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> gRPC-Web compatibility shim</span>
(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">() {
    </span>'use strict'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建grpc命名空间</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span> window.grpc === 'undefined'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        window.grpc </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {};
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span> window.grpc.web === 'undefined'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        window.grpc.web </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {};
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 方法类型枚举</span>
    window.grpc.web.MethodType =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        UNARY: </span>'unary'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        SERVER_STREAMING: </span>'server_streaming'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        CLIENT_STREAMING: </span>'client_streaming'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        BIDIRECTIONAL_STREAMING: </span>'bidirectional_streaming'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    };

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 方法描述符</span>
    window.grpc.web.MethodDescriptor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(path, methodType, requestType, responseType, requestSerializeFn, responseDeserializeFn) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.path =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> path;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.methodType =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> methodType;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.requestType =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> requestType;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.responseType =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> responseType;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.requestSerializeFn =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> requestSerializeFn;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.responseDeserializeFn =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> responseDeserializeFn;
    };

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 基础客户端类</span>
    window.grpc.web.GrpcWebClientBase = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(options) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.options = options ||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {};
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.format = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.options.format || 'text'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    };

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 服务端流式方法</span>
    window.grpc.web.GrpcWebClientBase.prototype.serverStreaming = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(url, request, metadata, methodDescriptor) {
        const self </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建简单的事件发射器</span>
        const stream =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            listeners: {},
            
            on: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(event, callback) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.listeners[event]) {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.listeners[event] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [];
                }
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.listeners[event].push(callback);
            },
            
            emit: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(event, data) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.listeners[event]) {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.listeners[event].forEach(callback =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> callback(data));
                }
            }
        };

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 序列化请求</span>
            const serializedRequest =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> methodDescriptor.requestSerializeFn(request);
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建gRPC-Web帧</span>
            const frameHeader = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Uint8Array(5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            frameHeader[</span>0] = 0; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 压缩标志</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            
            const messageLength </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> serializedRequest.length;
            frameHeader[</span>1] = (messageLength &gt;&gt;&gt; 24) &amp; 0xFF<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            frameHeader[</span>2] = (messageLength &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xFF<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            frameHeader[</span>3] = (messageLength &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xFF<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            frameHeader[</span>4] = messageLength &amp; 0xFF<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            
            const framedMessage </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Uint8Array(5 +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> messageLength);
            framedMessage.set(frameHeader, </span>0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            framedMessage.set(serializedRequest, </span>5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            
            const base64Request </span>= btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, framedMessage));
            
            const headers </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                </span>'Content-Type': 'application/grpc-web-text'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>'X-Grpc-Web': '1'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>'Accept': 'application/grpc-web-text'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            };
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加元数据</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (metadata) {
                Object.keys(metadata).forEach(key </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (key.toLowerCase() !== 'content-type'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                        headers[key] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> metadata[key];
                    }
                });
            }
            
            const fetchOptions </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                method: </span>'POST'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                headers: headers,
                body: base64Request
            };

            fetch(url, fetchOptions)
                .then(response </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">response.ok) {
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
                    }
                    
                    console.log(</span>'开始读取流式响应...'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                    
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用ReadableStream读取gRPC-Web流式响应</span>
                    const reader =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> response.body.getReader();
                    const decoder </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TextDecoder();
                    let buffer </span>= ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                    let messageCount </span>= 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                    
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> readStreamChunk() {
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> reader.read().then(({ done, value }) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (done) {
                                console.log(</span>'📡 流读取完成，总共处理消息:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, messageCount);
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (buffer.length &gt; 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                                    console.log(</span>'📦 处理流结束时的剩余缓冲区'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                                    processStreamBuffer();
                                }
                                stream.emit(</span>'end'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                            }
                            
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将新数据添加到缓冲区</span>
                            const chunk = decoder.decode(value, { stream: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
                            buffer </span>+=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> chunk;
                            console.log(</span>'📦 收到流数据块:', chunk.length, '字符，缓冲区总计:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, buffer.length);
                            
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理缓冲区中的完整消息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                            processStreamBuffer();
                            
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 继续读取</span>
                            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> readStreamChunk();
                        }).</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span>(error =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                            console.error(</span>'❌ 流读取错误:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error);
                            stream.emit(</span>'error'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error);
                        });
                    }
                    
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> processStreamBuffer() {
                        console.log(</span>'🔍 处理缓冲区，长度:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, buffer.length);
                        
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (buffer.length &gt; 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 查找完整的base64块</span>
                                let messageBase64 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> buffer;
                                
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查是否包含trailer标记</span>
                                const trailerMarkers = ['gAAAA', 'gAAA', 'gAA', 'gA'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
                                let trailerIndex </span>= -1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (const marker of trailerMarkers) {
                                    const index </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> messageBase64.indexOf(marker);
                                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (index &gt; 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                                        trailerIndex </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> index;
                                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                    }
                                }
                                
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (trailerIndex &gt; 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                                    messageBase64 </span>= messageBase64.substring(0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, trailerIndex);
                                    console.log(</span>'📦 在索引处找到trailer:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, trailerIndex);
                                }
                                
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 清理base64字符串</span>
                                const cleanBase64 = messageBase64.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9+/=]/g, '');
                                
                                <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 确保base64字符串长度是4的倍数</span>
                                let paddedBase64 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cleanBase64;
                                const padding </span>= paddedBase64.length % 4<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (padding &gt; 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                                    paddedBase64 </span>+= '='.repeat(4 -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> padding);
                                }
                                
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (paddedBase64.length === 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                                    console.log(</span>'❌ 清理后base64为空'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                                    buffer </span>= ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                }
                                
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 解码base64</span>
                                const binaryString =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> atob(paddedBase64);
                                const responseBytes </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Uint8Array(binaryString.length);
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (let i = 0; i &lt; binaryString.length; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                                    responseBytes[i] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
                                }
                                
                                console.log(</span>'📦 解码字节长度:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, responseBytes.length);
                                
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查是否有足够的数据来读取gRPC帧头</span>
                                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (responseBytes.length &gt;= 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                                    const compressionFlag </span>= responseBytes[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
                                    const frameMsgLength </span>= (responseBytes[1] &lt;&lt; 24) | (responseBytes[2] &lt;&lt; 16) | (responseBytes[3] &lt;&lt; 8) | responseBytes[4<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
                                    
                                    console.log(`📡 流帧: 压缩</span>=${compressionFlag}, 长度=${frameMsgLength}, 总计=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">${responseBytes.length}`);
                                    
                                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查是否有完整的消息数据</span>
                                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (responseBytes.length &gt;= 5 + frameMsgLength &amp;&amp; frameMsgLength &gt; 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                                        const messageBytes </span>= responseBytes.slice(5, 5 +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> frameMsgLength);
                                        
                                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                                            const response </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> methodDescriptor.responseDeserializeFn(messageBytes);
                                            messageCount</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                            console.log(`✅ 成功解析消息 #${messageCount}，发射数据`);
                                            stream.emit(</span>'data'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, response);
                                            
                                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理完成后，移除已处理的数据</span>
                                            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (trailerIndex &gt; 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                                                buffer </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> buffer.substring(trailerIndex);
                                                console.log(</span>'📦 移动缓冲区越过trailer，剩余长度:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, buffer.length);
                                            } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                                                buffer </span>= ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                                console.log(</span>'📦 完全清空缓冲区'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                                            }
                                            
                                        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (deserializeError) {
                                            console.error(</span>'❌ 反序列化错误:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, deserializeError);
                                            buffer </span>= ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                        }
                                    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                                        console.log(</span>'❌ 帧数据不完整或长度无效'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (buffer.length &lt; 200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                                            buffer </span>= ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                        }
                                    }
                                } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                                    console.log(</span>'❌ 帧太短，等待更多数据'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                }
                                
                            } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (parseError) {
                                console.error(</span>'❌ 处理流消息错误:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, parseError);
                                buffer </span>= ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                            }
                        }
                        
                        console.log(</span>'🔍 剩余缓冲区长度:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, buffer.length);
                    }
                    
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 开始读取流</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> readStreamChunk();
                })
                .</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span>(error =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                    console.error(</span>'流获取错误:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error);
                    stream.emit(</span>'error'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error);
                });
                
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {
            setTimeout(() </span>=&gt; stream.emit('error', error), 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stream;
    };

    console.log(</span>'gRPC-Web shim loaded successfully'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
})();</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>下面就是简单的获取实时数据的业务逻辑了</p>
<p>`client.js`</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> gRPC-Web Chat Client Implementation</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">class RealtimePushClient {
    constructor() {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.client = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.isConnected = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.serverUrl = 'https://localhost:5201'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 流式传输相关属性</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.currentStream = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.streamMessageCount = 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.streamStartTime = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.initializeUI();
    }

    initializeUI() {
        const streamButton </span>= document.getElementById('streamButton'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        const stopStreamButton </span>= document.getElementById('stopStreamButton'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        const clearButton </span>= document.getElementById('clearButton'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        streamButton.addEventListener(</span>'click', () =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.startStreamingChat());
        stopStreamButton.addEventListener(</span>'click', () =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.stopStreaming());
        clearButton.addEventListener(</span>'click', () =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.clearMessages());

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化连接状态</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.updateConnectionStatus(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>, '正在初始化...'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 页面加载时尝试连接</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.connect();
    }

    connect() {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化gRPC-Web客户端</span>
            console.log('正在初始化实时推送客户端...'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查必要的依赖是否可用</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span> jspb === 'undefined'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Error('google-protobuf 库未加载'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span> grpc === 'undefined' || !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">grpc.web) {
                console.warn(</span>'grpc-web 库未完全加载，等待重试...'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                setTimeout(() </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.connect(), 1000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span> proto === 'undefined' || !proto.chat || !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">proto.chat.ChatServiceClient) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Error('gRPC 生成的客户端代码未加载'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建gRPC-Web客户端</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.client = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> proto.chat.ChatServiceClient(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.serverUrl, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, {
                format: </span>'text'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                withCredentials: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            });
            
            console.log(</span>'实时推送客户端创建成功'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.updateConnectionStatus(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>, '已连接'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.addMessage('系统', '🚀 实时推送客户端已就绪', 'system'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {
            console.error(</span>'连接初始化失败:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.updateConnectionStatus(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>, '初始化失败'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.addMessage('系统', '初始化失败: ' + <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.getErrorMessage(error), 'error'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
    }

    startStreamingChat() {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.isConnected) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.addMessage('系统', '未连接到服务器，无法启动实时推送', 'error'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.client) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.addMessage('系统', 'gRPC客户端未初始化', 'error'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查是否已在流式传输</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.currentStream) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.addMessage('系统', '实时推送已在运行中', 'system'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建实时推送请求</span>
            const pushRequest = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> proto.chat.RealtimePushRequest();
            pushRequest.setClientId(</span>'web-client-' +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Date.now());
            pushRequest.setTimestamp(Math.floor(Date.now() </span>/ 1000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));

            console.log(</span>'启动实时推送:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, {
                clientId: pushRequest.getClientId(),
                timestamp: pushRequest.getTimestamp()
            });

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加流式传输的元数据</span>
            const metadata =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                </span>'x-user-agent': 'grpc-web-realtime-client'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            };

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 开始流式传输</span>
            const stream = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.client.startRealtimePush(pushRequest, metadata);
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">stream) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Error('无法创建实时推送连接'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 存储流引用</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.currentStream =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stream;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.streamMessageCount = 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.streamStartTime =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Date.now();

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新UI显示流式传输已激活</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.updateStreamingUI(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

            stream.on(</span>'data', (response) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (response &amp;&amp; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span> response.getData === 'function'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.streamMessageCount++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                    
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加带有实时数据特殊样式的消息</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.addRealtimeMessage(
                        `[${response.getDataType()}] ${response.getData()}`, 
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.streamMessageCount
                    );
                    
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新统计信息</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.updateStreamStats();
                }
            });

            stream.on(</span>'error', (error) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                console.error(</span>'实时推送错误:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.addMessage('系统', '实时推送错误: ' + <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.getErrorMessage(error), 'error'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.stopStreaming();
            });

            stream.on(</span>'end', () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                console.log(</span>'实时推送结束'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.addMessage('系统', '实时推送已结束', 'system'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.stopStreaming();
            });

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.addMessage('系统', '🚀 实时数据推送已启动', 'system'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {
            console.error(</span>'启动实时推送失败:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.addMessage('系统', '启动实时推送失败: ' + <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.getErrorMessage(error), 'error'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 其他方法实现...</span>
    updateConnectionStatus(connected, message = ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        const statusDiv </span>= document.getElementById('status'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        const streamButton </span>= document.getElementById('streamButton'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.isConnected =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> connected;
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (connected) {
            statusDiv.textContent </span>= '状态: 已连接' + (message ? ' - ' + message : ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            statusDiv.className </span>= 'status connected'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            streamButton.disabled </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            statusDiv.textContent </span>= '状态: 未连接' + (message ? ' - ' + message : ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            statusDiv.className </span>= 'status disconnected'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            streamButton.disabled </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }

    addMessage(sender, content, type) {
        const chatContainer </span>= document.getElementById('chatContainer'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        const messageDiv </span>= document.createElement('div'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        messageDiv.className </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `message ${type}`;
        
        const timestamp </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Date().toLocaleTimeString();
        messageDiv.innerHTML </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `
            </span>&lt;div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;${sender}&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;small&gt;${timestamp}&lt;/small&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;div&gt;${content}&lt;/div&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        `;

        chatContainer.appendChild(messageDiv);
        chatContainer.scrollTop </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> chatContainer.scrollHeight;
    }

    addRealtimeMessage(content, count) {
        const chatContainer </span>= document.getElementById('chatContainer'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        const messageDiv </span>= document.createElement('div'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        messageDiv.className </span>= 'message realtime'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        
        const timestamp </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Date().toLocaleTimeString();
        messageDiv.innerHTML </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `
            </span>&lt;div class="realtime-header"&gt;
                &lt;strong&gt;📡 实时数据 #${count}&lt;/strong&gt; 
                &lt;small&gt;${timestamp}&lt;/small&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;div class="realtime-content"&gt;${content}&lt;/div&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        `;

        chatContainer.appendChild(messageDiv);
        chatContainer.scrollTop </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> chatContainer.scrollHeight;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保持最后100条消息以防止内存问题</span>
        const messages = chatContainer.querySelectorAll('.message'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (messages.length &gt; 100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (let i = 0; i &lt; messages.length - 100; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                messages[i].remove();
            }
        }
    }

    getErrorMessage(error) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!error) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> '未知错误'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理gRPC-Web特定错误</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (error.code !==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> undefined) {
            const grpcErrorCodes </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                </span>0: 'OK'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>1: 'CANCELLED - 操作被取消'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>2: 'UNKNOWN - 未知错误'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>3: 'INVALID_ARGUMENT - 无效参数'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>4: 'DEADLINE_EXCEEDED - 请求超时'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>5: 'NOT_FOUND - 未找到'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>6: 'ALREADY_EXISTS - 已存在'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>7: 'PERMISSION_DENIED - 权限被拒绝'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>8: 'RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED - 资源耗尽'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>9: 'FAILED_PRECONDITION - 前置条件失败'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>10: 'ABORTED - 操作被中止'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>11: 'OUT_OF_RANGE - 超出范围'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>12: 'UNIMPLEMENTED - 未实现'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>13: 'INTERNAL - 内部错误'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>14: 'UNAVAILABLE - 服务不可用'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>15: 'DATA_LOSS - 数据丢失'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span>16: 'UNAUTHENTICATED - 未认证'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            };
            
            const codeDescription </span>= grpcErrorCodes[error.code] ||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `未知错误代码: ${error.code}`;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `gRPC错误: ${codeDescription}`;
        }
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> error.message ||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> error.toString();
    }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 页面加载时初始化实时推送客户端</span>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    window.realtimePushClient </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RealtimePushClient();
});</span></pre>
</div>

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;!</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">DOCTYPE html</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">html </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">lang</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="zh-CN"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 本地gRPC-Web兼容层 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">src</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="./grpc-web-shim.js"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 浏览器兼容的gRPC-Web文件 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">src</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="./generated/chat_pb_browser.js"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">src</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="./generated/chat_grpc_web_pb_browser.js"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主要客户端脚本 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">src</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="./client.js"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">body</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">html</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>直接双击index.html,或者通过http.server启动服务就能愉快的接收推送的实时数据了</p>
<p><img alt="Snipaste_2025-09-24_00-12-30" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202509/1099890-20250924001643621-1583204994.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>跟其他推送送相比，类型安全，性能高，压缩传输等等，但是前端支持相对没那么友好。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
